scope: Independent static review of exact-path commit, shared JSON overlays, preservation of unrelated staged/working changes, HEAD CAS and push.

validatedByInspection.claim: Commit tree starts from HEAD and overlays only exact validated paths; foreign staged trees are not used as the commit base.
A separate sync index starts from the original real index. Non-owned paths must retain their stage/mode/object and ls-files -v flags.

Shared files are overlaid separately on HEAD and existing-index blobs; unrelated rows/keys remain in their own prior state. The worklist changes only listed fields for D25-D30, history/evidence are append-merged, markdown changes only selected owned-row columns.

Lexical JSON replacement preserves bytes outside the targeted value and validates the semantic result; actual current worklist nested parents required by selected changed dictionaries were present in the index.
validatedByInspection.lines: scoped_json.py:31-64; read-only current HEAD/index/worktree data inspection

validatedByInspection.claim: Real index is locked with exclusive-create before final checks. Original index bytes, original HEAD, symbolic branch and input bytes are rechecked. Branch update uses update-ref expected old SHA rather than a blind move.
Push targets the exact newly created commit SHA to the captured branch without --force or force-with-lease; upstream divergence is rejected normally.
The reviewed commit code does not rewrite working-tree sources. Thumbnail apply is a separate optional preparatory mutation, not part of the scoped commit.
Prepare inventory now disables optional Git index refresh for git status.

findings.detail: Earlier prepare git status inherited optional index locks and could refresh the actual index stat cache. Parent added GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0; confirmed in the final reviewed source.

--apply-thumbnails serializes the whole registry and read_text/write_text normalizes ignore newlines/trailing whitespace. It preserves unrelated semantic entries but not their exact bytes. Parent states this optional application already happened once and will not be repeated; commit_scope overlays only the four owned entries and exact exceptions into HEAD and index.

If update-ref succeeds but os.replace(index.lock,index) fails, the new commit remains on the branch while the original real index remains. The exception path removes its lock and writes interrupted.json with refUpdated=true; it does not install sync-index or roll back the ref. Foreign staged entries are not lost, but owned paths can appear reversed/staged against the new HEAD. A blind rerun is not a recovery procedure.
recovery: Pause other index/ref writers and inspect the saved run plan, interrupted.json when present, original index backup and sync-index. Confirm the branch is still the recorded new commit and the current real index is byte-identical to the recorded original before replacing anything.

Preferred completion: under a newly acquired exclusive index lock, install the already prepared sync-index only after those equality checks and source checks. Recheck foreign stage/mode/flags and intended shared overlays, then write the completion receipt. Do not push before recovery verification.

Alternative rollback only if the branch still equals the recorded new commit and real index still equals the original: compare-and-swap the branch back to the recorded base. The original index is already present; do not overwrite it unnecessarily. Keep the new commit and saved run recoverable.

If either HEAD or index has advanced since the failure, do not restore the full backup and do not force-move the branch. Preserve the new current index/ref and reconcile the owned overlays against that state explicitly.
A hard process termination after ref update may leave index.lock without interrupted.json. Preserve the lock and run files as evidence first; do not blindly delete a possibly active process lock.

limitations: No dry-run or execute mode of the reviewed scripts was run, no synthetic repository was created, and no fault injection was performed; this is static review plus bounded read-only current-state inspection.

Future foreign edits within the same explicitly owned scalar or newly added dictionary are not protected as distinct ownership: those values are selected wholesale. Parent must continue selecting only this batch-owned current deltas.
Current review is not proof that runtime media-policy checks, every final selected path, or future race conditions pass; execute-mode assertions remain the runtime gate.
recommendation: Proceed with parent-reviewed exact owned paths after all selected production files are stable. Retain the saved original/sync indexes and receipts. No current evidence of unrelated staged-path inclusion or working-file loss was found.
